finding.claim: ADR 0046 presents the history scan for missing decisions as an existing kmctl feature and commits to building it, but nothing of it exists yet and the next ticket (decision-gaps-measure) is a prototype whose README ends with a verdict on whether to build `kmctl decision gaps` and the skill at all.

fixes.change: The decision no longer lists the history scan among what kmctl does and says it goes in kmctl only if measuring it says to build it.
